modelNotes.gpt-5.1: GPT-5.1 handles full-depth founder and company scoring with detailed reasoning.
modelNotes.gpt-5.1-mini: GPT-5.1 Mini is a faster, lower-cost option — good for high-volume or lighter-weight scoring.
modelNotes.gpt-5: GPT-5 offers strong general-purpose reasoning for founder and company scoring.
modelNotes.gpt-4.1: GPT-4.1 works well for scoring tasks that involve long company documents.
modelNotes.gpt-4o: GPT-4o offers fast, cost-efficient scoring with solid general reasoning.
modelNotes.claude-sonnet-5: Claude Sonnet 5 balances quality and speed — a strong default for founder/company scoring.
modelNotes.claude-opus-4-8: Claude Opus 4.8 is Anthropic's most capable model — best for the most nuanced, highest-stakes scoring.
modelNotes.claude-fable-5: Claude Fable 5 is tuned for fast, lightweight scoring at lower cost.
modelNotes.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001: Claude Haiku 4.5 is the fastest, most affordable option — suited for quick or high-volume scoring.
